list: Competition kit list frozen 2026-11-18; not independently verified in-game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this as the reward for earning the other single-player trophies. Work through the story, completion checklist, and remaining miscellaneous objectives.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx identifies Gone Fishing as the first main mission of Chapter 1 and describes this unlock as automatic.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — According to PowerPyx, this chapter milestone unlocks after the first Chapter 2 mission, What’s in the Bag?.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — According to PowerPyx, the Chapter 2 milestone unlocks after the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places the unlock after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx associates this milestone with Starting From Zero in Chapter 4. Exact chapter sequencing is unconfirmed because its same guide also lists a Chapter 5 mission.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx associates the final mission trophy with Starting From Zero in Chapter 4, but also lists a Chapter 5 mission. The precise final-mission placement remains unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 and describes the trophy as an automatic story unlock.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and describes the trophy as an automatic story unlock.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places Child’s Play in Chapter 4 and describes the trophy as an automatic story unlock.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places Headliners in Chapter 4 and describes the trophy as an automatic story unlock.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 and describes the trophy as an automatic story unlock.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx places Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 and calls this an automatic story unlock. Its final-mission chapter placement elsewhere conflicts, so the overall sequence is unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says the checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, while earlier progress counts. It recommends scanning vehicles and studying animals as you play, then finishing the checklist in free roam.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says any combination of stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps counts. Track categories under Progress > Activities > Stunts. The 100% checklist calls for 300, beyond this trophy’s 250.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists nine activity types, including fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, a race win and a stunt. Check Progress > Activities for what you have tried.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx links a separate guide for 12 shooting ranges and 42 gold medals. Specific challenge tactics are unconfirmed in the roadmap itself.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx links a guide covering 14 Top Fun locations. The precise requirements within each location are unconfirmed in the roadmap itself.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx links a guide to 40 unique races. The roadmap does not detail which routes are easiest, so route choice remains unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says Cal texts a purple fishing marker sometime after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Follow his fishing questline to reach the challenge.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says the home television offers three playable games from Chapter 1. Finish all levels of any one game. It says the arcade game Bang For Your Buck is another option.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — As Lucia in Chapter 3, PowerPyx says Andy calls and sends an address in Belville. Follow the five-part line through Puff Puff Pass. The guide says the quests remain available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, PowerPyx says Kenton calls and appears at Key Lento. Recover and return treasures from seven shipwrecks. He can temporarily disappear but returns later and remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says Billy’s line appears at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Chapter 2’s Coffee Break. Finish its five quests through Hometown Heroes. The line remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx identifies Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as counting strands, while several other optional questlines do not count. Follow eight qualifying strands to completion. The guide says they remain accessible after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Chapter 3’s Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS, PowerPyx says Randy’s Wish List tracks 16 cars under Map > Robberies. Deliver the requested vehicles to his Vice City garage. The list remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says Jason can begin Tyrone’s lab questline after Chapter 3’s Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the marked synthetic labs, then complete the follow-up Spin On This. It remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — Potentially missable. During Chapter 1 at Jason’s house, PowerPyx reports a morning encounter after Down to Earth, though timing can vary. Speak to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. This session disappears after Chapter 1. Whether it is required for the trophy is unconfirmed. The guide lists 18 meditations across 10 locations and tracks them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.missableStatus: Potentially missable

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says Bret texts Jason after Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Follow the hunting requests and return the animals. Which animal triggers this trophy is unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx links a card-set location guide, but the roadmap gives no individual locations or set recommendations. Which sets are quickest is unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says to use WAiNK by holding Up and R1 to scan environmental objects. It lists landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags among the eligible locations.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says 50 of 80 challenges suffice for this trophy, while 70 are needed for its 100% checklist. Review completed entries under Progress > Challenges and select remaining objectives.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, PowerPyx says to call your partner, build a four-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. It suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia as an escape route.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Coffee Break, call your partner and rob three marked targets while police actively chase you. PowerPyx suggests the northern Vice City jewelry stores after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs and notes that the unlock may be delayed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx recommends scanning passing vehicles with WAiNK by holding Up then R1. It says scanning counts without driving each vehicle and suggests checking Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says to aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to activate Combat Focus. Line up five gang-operation enemies and defeat them within one activation. It suggests adrenaline to extend the window.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx recommends a passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge at VCIA, such as the one at E3/E4. Enter the cockpit, take off and fly about 1 km away. Planes parked on the airfield reportedly do not count.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx identifies tanks at Mile Zero Air Station on the southwestern island in Mariana County. Enter one and fire on enemies until the trophy appears.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Chapter 3’s Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, PowerPyx says the Snap Gun permits silent entry through a store’s back door. Find the safe code, loot the safe, disable the alarm and destroy the security footage before leaving.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is introduces bank vault jobs. Follow the security van, enter the opened vault with your partner, take the cash and escape. Five of the eight jobs are needed for this trophy.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is counts toward this trophy. Follow the armored truck to the bank, take the cash from the open vault and escape the heat radius.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says to clear all map fog, suggesting a plane to reach uncovered areas. Fly over the remaining dark regions until the full map is visible.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists nine gangs and says to complete one illegal operation for each. Track the gang totals under Progress > Gangs. It says the 100% checklist requires all 39 operations.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx directs players to Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. Buy an Apple Martini and drink it near the bar.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS grants the Key Cloner, PowerPyx says to steal the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window, then continue down the street.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx identifies Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. Obtain the watch, shotgun and safe contents, then escape the police. It says missed valuables can be collected after the robbery respawns.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says both Jason and Lucia need maximum strength. After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, work out with both characters and check their strength in the character progress screen.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx reports a 500-action criminal-profile counter and suggests enabling its HUD notifications. Stealthy robberies and combat choices can affect the profile. The guide warns that the Irredeemable profile is permanent.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. PowerPyx says the trigger is currently unknown. Its possible connection to a prologue location is speculation.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx describes a nighttime UFO encounter northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 a.m. Go alone, look for the blinking roadside car, follow the path and help the woman return to her car. The encounter may not spawn every visit.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. PowerPyx says the exact trigger is currently unknown and offers a motorcycle melee interpretation as speculation.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Chapter 3’s Credit Check, PowerPyx says the Dye Pack Jammer enables laundering marked bills. Rob banks or payday-loan stores and deliver a cumulative $250,000 to fences.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx suggests buying guns, vehicle modifications and tattoos toward the cumulative $100,000 shop-spending total.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx says eight garages are purchased through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after Chapter 2’s Daily Driver. It lists a combined purchase cost of $160,000.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — After Chapter 2’s Moses mission installs Scooter Bros, PowerPyx says to buy enough garage spaces, take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and select Respray and Register. Ten registrations are needed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies
